title: 实验设计、记录与数据
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/183_实验设计、记录与数据.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/183_实验设计、记录与数据/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本装订好的实验记录本和一支笔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a bound hardcover lab notebook and a pen beside a small bar chart icon, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十一课：实验设计、记录与数据。

shots.scene: 阿杰用铅笔在纸巾上记了菌落数
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scribbles numbers with a pencil on a crumpled paper towel next to two petri dishes, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰把菌落数用铅笔记在纸巾上。

shots.scene: 两组只做了一次，阿杰说处理有效
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points proudly at two single plates of different colony counts, a question mark floats above.
shots.narration: 两组各做一次，他就说处理有效。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一本记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a bound lab notebook and taps the cover, the safety administrator nodding behind.
shots.narration: 小研：设计、记录、统计，一样不能少。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light bulb turning into a clear question card with a check box for test, no words. No text.
shots.narration: 先提出一个能检验的假设。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two identical setups where only one knob differs, other knobs locked with small padlocks. No text.
shots.narration: 只改一个变量，其他条件保持一致。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: samples picked from all corners of a field rather than one spot, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 取样要有代表性，不能只取一处。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three identical flasks side by side for one treatment, a replicate badge. No text.
shots.narration: 同一处理做几个重复。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a treatment group next to a control group with a balance scale between them. No text.
shots.narration: 还要设对照，才有比较的基准。

shots.scene: 只挑好看的样本会偏倚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand picking only the nicest looking plates from a pile, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只挑好看的样本，结果就有偏倚。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dice icon assigning sample tubes into two groups. No text.
shots.narration: 随机分组，减少人为偏向。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plates with covered group labels being counted by a person icon, a blindfold icon. No text.
shots.narration: 计数时不看组别，结果更客观。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calculator and a notebook before a row of flasks, a clock showing before start. No text.
shots.narration: 动手前，先估算需要多少样本。

shots.scene: 多一轮培养多一次接触和废物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an extra culture round adding a hand exposure icon and an extra waste bag. No text.
shots.narration: 多一轮培养，就多一次接触和废物。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: just enough flasks with a check mark, an excess pile crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 重复够用就好，每次都规范操作。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook page leading to the same experiment repeated by another person icon. No text.
shots.narration: 记下来，自己和别人才能重复验证。

shots.scene: 论文报告的原始数据来自记录本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a notebook to a paper and a report, a patent certificate icon beside. No text.
shots.narration: 论文数据出自记录本，还能证明发明。

shots.scene: 出了事故从记录找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a notebook page next to a small accident warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 出了事故，也能从记录里找原因。

shots.scene: 独立探究以记录本为核心
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student plans a project with an open notebook at the center of the desk.
shots.narration: 独立探究，记录本就是核心。

shots.scene: 活页夹之外，再用一本记录本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring binder of loose sheets next to a bound notebook with a star. No text.
shots.narration: 资料夹之外，还要一本实验记录本。

shots.scene: 记录本是正式的科学文件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bound notebook with a seal icon, an arrow showing all lab actions going into it. No text.
shots.narration: 它是正式的科学文件，所做的都要记。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the first pages of a notebook marked as a blank index table with rows. No text.
shots.narration: 前几页留作目录：题目、日期、起始页。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand writing in the top margin of a blank numbered notebook page with a black ink pen.
shots.narration: 每页要有页码、题目和日期。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook page bottom with two signature lines, one for the author and one for a witness. No text.
shots.narration: 本人签名，再请核验人签字。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook page with icons for a target, a reagent bottle, a scale and numbered steps. No text.
shots.narration: 写清目的、材料、用量和步骤。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a color change, a thermometer, a clock and a humidity drop beside a notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 记下现象、条件和温度等环境因素。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook page ending with a table, a chart and a conclusion check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 最后写结果、分析和结论。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pen with a check mark and a pencil with an eraser crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一律用不易褪色的笔，不用铅笔。

shots.scene: 【实拍】写错划一条线，签名注日期
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand drawing a single straight line through one written number in a notebook, the old number still readable, writing the new value beside it.
shots.narration: 写错划一道，原字看得清，签名注日期。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eraser, correction fluid and a torn page, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不擦、不涂黑、不撕页。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a printed chart and a photo glued onto a notebook page, a glue stick. No text.
shots.narration: 图表照片贴在对应页，可用图表记数据。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: neat handwriting lines on a page and a crossed out messy scribble. No text.
shots.narration: 字迹清楚，除单位外少用缩写。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand writing a small page reference at the bottom right corner of a notebook page.
shots.narration: 没写完，右下角写转第几页。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two notebook pages with arrows linking the bottom of one to the top of a later page, another experiment in between. No text.
shots.narration: 续页左上角写接第几页，不会乱。

shots.scene: 空白处画斜线，签名日期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a half empty notebook page with a diagonal line across the blank area and a signature mark. No text.
shots.narration: 不跳页；没写满，空白画斜线签名。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook page with hazard pictogram icons next to a reagent list. No text.
shots.narration: 用了哪些危险试剂，记下来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of goggles, gloves, a fume hood and a procedure binder beside a notebook line. No text.
shots.narration: 防护措施、依据的规程，记下来。

shots.scene: 风险评估结论、异常和事故
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk checklist and a small warning icon pointing into the notebook, then a report arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 评估结论、异常和事故，如实记并报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical cabinet with a logbook hanging beside it, a pen writing a row. No text.
shots.narration: 危化品领用，当场登记台账。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab instrument with a usage log sheet on a clipboard next to it. No text.
shots.narration: 大型仪器用前用后，填使用记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety inspection checklist with a date and signature, a backdated entry crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 检查记录当场填，不补填、不代签。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in her notebook right after placing a tube in a rack, wearing goggles.
shots.narration: 做一步，记一步，当场写下来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook line with a clock icon next to each entry. No text.
shots.narration: 每条记录写清时间。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person writing at home at night from memory, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 事后补记、随意改，记录就不真了。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unexpected result icon and a small spill icon both written into the notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 异常和意外，也要如实记下来。

shots.scene: 共用账号，找不到操作人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one login card shared by three person icons, an instrument record with a question mark for who. No text.
shots.narration: 共用账号，记录就找不到人。

shots.scene: 脏手套太笨，字迹看不清
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick dirty glove smudging a notebook page, crossed out, a clean pen hand beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 戴着脏手套写，字看不清还污染本子。

shots.scene: 嫌麻烦回头补，时间就乱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock with tangled hands next to a notebook, a later note arrow crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 嫌防护麻烦回头补，时间就乱了。

shots.scene: 一人一号，安心操作当场记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each person icon with their own login card, a calm worker writing in a notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 一人一号，安心操作，才能当场如实记。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons crossed out, picking data points, changing a number and deleting a row. No text.
shots.narration: 数据不挑、不改、不删。

shots.scene: 异常值按事先规则剔除并写明理由
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one outlier dot removed following a rule card written before the experiment, a note explaining why. No text.
shots.narration: 剔除异常值，按事先规则，写明理由。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a failed result page kept in the notebook with a check mark, not torn out. No text.
shots.narration: 结果不合预期，也如实记录和报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fake data sheet stamped with a red seal, a scale of justice icon. No text.
shots.narration: 编造、篡改数据，是科研失信。

shots.scene: 原始文件不动，副本上分析
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an original data file with a lock icon and a copy file being analyzed on a laptop. No text.
shots.narration: 原始文件不动，在副本上分析。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: data copied to two storage icons, a calendar showing a retention period. No text.
shots.narration: 电子数据及时备份，按规定期限保存。

shots.scene: 样品标清来源、代次、日期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rack of culture flasks each with a blank label and a register book beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 样品菌种标清来源、代次、日期，登记在册。

shots.scene: 原始记录归单位，离开交回
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook handed back to a lab supervisor at a desk, a backpack with a notebook crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 原始记录归单位，离开时交回，不外传。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a huge stack of plates and a long sequence strip, a dizzy eye icon. No text.
shots.narration: 菌落数、序列，光靠眼睛看不过来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a set of dots with a center line for the mean and a band showing spread. No text.
shots.narration: 平均值看集中，标准差看离散程度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: data points flowing into a test icon and a trend line emerging. No text.
shots.narration: 统计能概括数据、检验假设、找规律。

shots.scene: 两组不一样，是真是碰巧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two groups of dots with slightly different averages and a coin flip icon between them. No text.
shots.narration: 两组结果不同，可能只是碰巧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance tipping clearly to one side with a significance badge. No text.
shots.narration: 比处理、比菌株，靠统计判断显著性。

shots.scene: 阿杰重新设计，每组做重复
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sets up three replicate plates for each group, writing in a bound notebook.
shots.narration: 阿杰重新设计，每组都做了重复。

shots.scene: 计完数的平板灭菌处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: counted plates going into an autoclave bag, then an autoclave icon. No text.
shots.narration: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再处置。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a student's notebook with a blank rubric sheet, pointing at page numbers.
shots.narration: 老师看组织、页码、内容和核验。

shots.scene: 带着规范和评分表来问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student brings his notebook and a blank rubric sheet to ask a question, the teacher smiling.
shots.narration: 有疑问，带着规范和评分表来问。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a light bulb, a balance, three flasks and a dice, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 设计：假设、对照、重复、随机。

shots.scene: 装订本、编页码、用笔、划改签名
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bound notebook, a page number, a pen and a single line correction with a signature, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 记录：当场记，用笔写，划改签名。

shots.scene: 不挑不改不删，备份可追溯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked original file, a backup copy and a chain of arrows back to the notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 数据：如实完整，一人一号，可追溯。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一份装订好的实验报告
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a neatly stapled lab report with blank pages and a reference list icon, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：实验报告与学术规范。
